Why Do Digital Games Cost The Same As Retail Copies?

The people who produce a product usually agree not to sell it at a rate that is below what the middlemen (bestbuy walmart lowes whatever) sell it at. This way they can sell in bulk to some and direct to others plus it allows them to make a higher markup when they sell it one at a time instead of 500-1,000,000 at a time. Most large retail sources insist on this being part of the contract or they would be unable to compete with the vendor.

This applies to most products including video games.
